mods.name: Artists' Guild - Get your faction items
mods.summary: Adds a forge for every vanilla faction where players can obtain any transferable vanilla item.
mods.description:
Gives each vanilla race its own forge to obtain all transferable items the base game has (marked by which game they came from, plus Cathay caravan items). It uses existing vanilla items rather than new ones, works only for players, and is the English-interface version; a Chinese-interface version exists.

It works with SFO and Radious and most mods, but not with similar item mods. Mods that change vanilla item data can break the forge's references.

It was named in the Miao Alchemy channel as the source of a mechanic there.
features: Access to all transferable vanilla items
